content: Kiara Sen called Sunita Agarwal to discuss her recent policy cancellation and inquire about short-term bridge coverage. Sunita explained a 30-day bridge rider option that is 8% higher in premium and offered to email the quote and details. Kiara confirmed her account has no outstanding balance and stated she will review the bridge option and follow up.

action_items: Sunita Agarwal to email the bridge coverage quote and signature link to Kiara
Kiara Sen to review the bridge option
